B0GQGY896M.title: Govee Ceiling Fans with Lights and Remote, RGBIC Smart 52'' flush mount
bullets: Dual-Layer Custom Lighting: Features an independent RGBWW main smart ceiling light for daily tasks plus an RGBICWW ambient backlight for an immersive atmosphere. Freely blend colors and brightness to unlock endless personalized combinations for any occasion.

Powerful Yet Quiet Air Circulation: Govee Fandelier Ceiling Fan with light delivers rapid cooling with powerful airflow up to 5000 CFM. Its ultra-quiet motor operates at as low as 30dB, and 6 adjustable speeds ensure a customized comfort experience day and night.

More Precise RGBIC Color Expression: Govee Ceiling Fan brings the latest LuminBlend+ technology with 16-bit processing. Compared to traditional RGB Lights, it offers richer colors, smoother gradients, and consistent accuracy, bringing more vivid hues to your space.

Dimmable Smart Lighting: This ceiling fan with lights delivers up to 2800lm from its main lamp for whole-room illumination. A wide color temperature range (1000K-10000K) shifts from warm candlelight to bright daylight. Ideal for bedrooms, game rooms, and home offices.

Reversible DC Motor: This bedroom fan's DC motor switches between downdraft cooling in summer and updraft circulation for heating in winter. Enjoy year-round comfort with reduced energy costs and efficient climate control through all four seasons.

Please Update to The Latest APP Version — it optimizes minimum fan speed and Matter connectivity for the best experience. Additionally, this product is Matter‑certified and supports whole‑home integration. Occasional communication error alerts may appear due to protocol variability, but these do not affect fan operation or lighting Matter functions; the device remains fully stable.

Effortless Smart Control: Operate via app, remote, or voice with Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings. Unlock more features for this smart ceiling fan, access timers, custom settings, and DreamView with other Govee lights in Govee Home App. Plus, AI Lighting Bot 2.0 turns speak, text, or snap into personalized effects, and refines them through conversation—making lighting smarter and truly bespoke.

B0GR3WJL89.title: Linkind Matter 52" Smart Ceiling Fan with Lights and Remote, Black
bullets: 【No Dimmer & Controller Compatibility】This fan is not compatible with wall dimmer switches or fan speed controllers. All speed and lighting adjustments must be made through the APP or included remote. Supports 2.4 GHz WiFi only (5 GHz not supported). Requires 2 AAA batteries (not included). Does not support Thread.

【Matter Certified + 4 Control Methods】This smart ceiling fan works with Alexa/Apple/Google Home/SmartThings. Control via voice, app, remote (one-to-many & group control) and standard wall switch (limited to on/off function). Please note: NOT Compatible with Dimmer Switches or Speed Controllers. No ecosystem lock-in—this RGB ceiling fan adapts to your lifestyle.

【32-Zone RGB Lighting via AiDot APP】Experience RGB ceiling fan lighting with 32 independent zones for multi-color effects which powered by Aurascape technology beyond RGB fans. The included remote offers quick access to 7 preset dynamic scenes.​ Advanced customization is available exclusively through the AiDot APP, including individual zone control, Playlist lighting sequences, and access to all 16 million colors.

【Quiet DC Motor with 6 Speeds & 4 Wind Modes】 Enjoy up to 5000 CFM airflow with a library-quiet DC motor (≤45dB). Easily adjust 6 fan speeds levels (1%–100%) and 4 wind modes (Constant, Dynamic, Sleep, and Reverse) using the remote or AiDot APP. Customize Dynamic and Sleep modes in the app(sync your settings to the remote). Designed for year-round comfort with cooling airflow in summer and reverse circulation in winter.

【Independent Timers & Countdown Shutoff】Set separate schedules for the fan and light or use countdown timers through the AiDot APP for automatic shutoff. The remote handles everyday controls, while the APP provides advanced timer customization. Perfect for bedrooms, kids' rooms, and living spaces while helping you save energy effortlessly.

【Easy Installation – Ready in Under 30 Minutes】 The built-in receiver eliminates the need for a separate control box, making installation faster and easier. Compatible with standard downrod and angled ceilings up to 15°, requiring only a simple 3-wire connection (live, neutral, ground). Includes a detailed manual and video guide for quick setup.

【From Warm Candlelight to Dynamic Light Shows】 Customize lighting from 1800K warm candlelight to 6500K daylight with 1%-100% brightness. Use the AiDot APP to unlock Music Sync, where lights react to your music with dynamic color effects. This smart ceiling fan is perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and covered patios.

【Reversible Blades for Indoor & Covered Outdoor Use】 Choose Medium Walnut or Matte Black blade finishes to match your décor. Suitable for spaces from 12 ft. x 12 ft. to 20 ft. x 20 ft., this ceiling fan provides efficient airflow for bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, patios, porches, and gazebos. Ideal as an outdoor ceiling fan with light for covered spaces, it offers two styles and versatile placement throughout your home.

B0GSXQFW4C.title: Govee Ceiling Fan with Lights, 20'' RGBIC Fandelier Ceiling Fan with Light
bullets: Dual-Layer Customizable Lighting: The Govee ceiling fan with lights features two light layers that are independently controllable via the Govee Home App (Matter/remote do not support this), each equipped with 126 RGB LED beads and 90 white LED beads. Each IC integrates 6 sets of LEDs, delivering smooth RGBIC lighting effects to meet your various daily needs.

Powerful Oscillating Fan: With max airflow of 1000 CFM, 30° oscillation range (15° fixed deflection on one side) and 12 adjustable speed settings, the oscillating ceiling fans with lights deliver effective cooling, ensuring comprehensive airflow coverage throughout the entire room and meeting all cooling needs.

Dimmable Smart Lighting: The Govee ceiling fans with lights deliver up to 3100lm, easily illuminating whole rooms. Wide 2700K-6500K color temp switches from candlelight to daylight, making the bladeless ceiling fan a good choice for bedrooms, gaming rooms and home offices.

Quiet Reversible DC Motor: This bedroom fan's DC motor switches between downdraft cooling in summer and updraft circulation for heating in winter. Noise as low as 30 dB, operates quietly without disturbance. Suitable for all seasons, it saves energy and provides round-the-clock comfort.

Effortless Smart Control: Enjoy ultimate convenience with app, remote and voice control via Alexa, Google Assistant, Matter and SmartThings. Unlock additional features for smart ceiling fan through the Govee app, such as Timer, Personalized Settings and DreamView integrated with other Govee lights.

Extensive Scene Modes: The smart ceiling fan with lights offers 65+ scene modes that you can switch between with a single touch, effortlessly adapting to different moods—such as parties, relaxation, and sleep—to create the perfect lighting experience and brighten up your life.
AI Generative Lighting: Speak. Text. Snap. AI lighting bot 2.0 turns intent into personalized lighting effect—and refines it through conversation. Design smarter.

Note: This product is Matter-certified and supports whole-home smart home integration.
